name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 20 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-07-11, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.58 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
